# Build Ezy

> Build Ezy is an AI-powered website operating system: design, launch, sell, and grow a business from one connected platform. No code required.

Build Ezy lets anyone — solo founders, freelancers, agencies, and growing businesses — build a professional, responsive website with a visual drag-and-drop builder, then connect commerce, CRM, analytics, and AI agents without stitching together separate tools.

## Key capabilities
- Visual website builder with full control over layout, typography, color, media, and motion
- AI website generation from a plain-language brief
- AI agents that assist with content, design, and business workflows
- Built-in CRM to manage leads, customers, and conversations
- Smart commerce: products, orders, and payments in one flow
- Business intelligence and live analytics
- Responsive previews, custom domains, and professional publishing

## Who it's for
- Agencies managing multiple client sites from one workspace
- Solo founders launching a first business presence
- Freelancers building and maintaining client websites
- Businesses that want their website, commerce, and analytics connected
